# Module notes

<!-- provenance -->
> **AI-written interpretation** of the code at commit `71fae62`, based on the extracted facts (`integrations.md`, `change-impact.md`, `architecture.md`, `data-model.md`, `graph.json`) and sampled source. Verify details against the code.


One sentence on what each busy folder, and each file to be careful with, is for. Written from names only (paths, function and class names), not from reading the code.

## Folders

- `btc_signal_engine/adapters`: Contains adapters for various services and functionalities.
- `btc_signal_engine/application`: Handles application-level operations and agent management.
- `btc_signal_engine/domain`: Defines domain-level concepts and utilities.
- `btc_signal_engine/domain/models`: Holds models related to trading decisions and outcomes.
- `btc_signal_engine/domain/settlement`: Manages settlement calculations and scoring.
- `btc_signal_engine/adapters/sqlite`: Provides SQLite database interactions and operations.
- `btc_signal_engine/domain/coach`: Offers decision-making and value assessment tools.
- `btc_signal_engine/bootstrap`: Sets up and manages application runtime and processes.
- `btc_signal_engine/adapters/kalshi`: Interacts with Kalshi trading and data services.
- `btc_signal_engine/adapters/polymarket_us`: Handles Polymarket trading and market data.
- `btc_signal_engine/domain/features`: Defines market feature calculations and states.
- `btc_signal_engine/domain/horizons`: Manages time boundaries and horizon calculations.

## Files to be careful with

- `btc_signal_engine/application/trading.py`: Implements trading services and configurations.
- `btc_signal_engine/application/ports.py`: Defines interfaces for external services and gateways.
- `evals/graders/__init__.py`: Grades and evaluates data based on various criteria.
- `btc_signal_engine/adapters/polymarket_us/trading.py`: Manages Polymarket trading operations and orders.
- `btc_signal_engine/application/notifier.py`: Handles notifications and message composition.
